notes: 40 concepts, 1 static each. 50/50: W43_01–20 winning personas (nurse, CNA), W43_21–40 net-new (housekeeping, gifting, weight-loss walker x5 each + 5 other tests). 12 Spanish. GIF blocks mark candidates; render them only after the static is approved (--gif-only). No invented named testimonials: quotes are real review language or unattributed first-person copy.

concepts.angle: Dear Nurses v3: shift + condition callouts
concepts.based_on: Library C01; winner 'Dear Nurses, Work 12-hour shifts pain-free' ($230k, 4.34 ROAS)
concepts.headline: Dear Nurses, Work 12-hour shifts without the heel pain.
concepts.prompt: Minimal ad on a clean off-white background. Top: two-line headline, first line "Dear Nurses," in extra-bold black, second line "Work 12-hour shifts without the heel pain." in regular black. Center: the shoe from the reference photo in side profile, large, studio-lit. Four thin curved arrows with two-line labels (bold first line, light second line): "Arch support / for plantar fasciitis", "Wide toe-box / room for bunions", "Stretch-knit upper / gives as feet swell", "Grippy sole / for wet hospital floors".

concepts.angle: 12-HOUR SHIFT SHOES checklist on a real hospital scene
concepts.based_on: Library C02; $858k '12-HOUR SHIFT SHOES' winner + I3 '5 reasons' photo format
concepts.headline: 12-HOUR SHIFT SHOES
concepts.prompt: Photo-real ad: a nurse in navy scrubs standing in a bright hospital corridor, cropped from the waist down, wearing the shoe from the reference photo. Left side: a white rounded card with bold black title "12-HOUR SHIFT SHOES" and five lines with purple check icons: "Cushion that lasts to hour 12", "Arch support for plantar fasciitis", "Wide toe-box for swelling", "Grip for wet floors", "Under $60".

frames.edit: Remove the last two check lines ("Grip for wet floors" and "Under $60") from the card, leaving empty card space.
Remove the check lines "Arch support for plantar fasciitis" and "Wide toe-box for swelling" from the card, leaving only the title and the first line.

concepts.angle: Everything nurses tried, crossed out, then the solution
concepts.based_on: Library C03; $90k 'HOKA/SKECHERS/ORTHOFEET/CROCS/INSOLES → SOLUTION' winner; scripts 'cushioning lasts about two hours'
concepts.headline: Running shoes. $300 orthotics. Gel insoles. Clogs. → SOLUTION
concepts.prompt: Split ad. Left half on white: a stacked list in bold navy capitals, each line struck through with a thick red line: "RUNNING SHOES", "$300 ORTHOTICS", "GEL INSOLES", "CLOGS". Under the list, small grey text: "Flat by hour 4." Right half on soft lavender: bold navy title "SOLUTION", small text under it "Built for 12-hour shifts", and the shoe from the reference photo in side profile. Every one of the four list items must have its own red strike line.

frames.edit: Remove the right half's title "SOLUTION", the text under it and the shoe, leaving plain lavender.
Remove the red strike lines from "GEL INSOLES" and "CLOGS" only; keep the other two strike lines.

concepts.angle: Stage progression: what wrong shoes do over 12 hours
concepts.based_on: Library C05; I14/I66 'stages' inspiration; scripts
concepts.headline: The 4 stages of a 12-hour shift in the wrong shoes
concepts.prompt: Infographic ad on a deep navy background. Top headline in white: "The 4 stages of a 12-hour shift" and second line in lavender: "in the wrong shoes". A row of four rounded panels, each a semi-transparent glowing foot x-ray with a red pain glow that grows stronger from left to right, each labeled with a purple pill "HOUR 2", "HOUR 6", "HOUR 8", "HOUR 12" and a caption under it: "Cushion goes flat", "Heel starts to ache", "Feet swell, toes pinch", "Limping to the car". Bottom: the shoe from the reference photo in side profile with white text "Or wear shoes built for hour 12."

frames.edit: Remove the bottom shoe and the text "Or wear shoes built for hour 12.", and remove the fourth panel (HOUR 12).

concepts.angle: Mechanism: why heels hurt at hour 8 (anatomy split)
concepts.based_on: Library C07; plantar-fascia anatomy winners + I44/I70 anatomy marker
concepts.headline: Why your heels hurt at hour 8
concepts.prompt: Ad on soft lavender. Top headline in bold purple capitals: "WHY YOUR HEELS HURT AT HOUR 8". Left half: a clean medical illustration of a foot skeleton with the plantar fascia highlighted and a red glow at the heel, caption "Flat cushioning strains the plantar fascia". Right half: the shoe from the reference photo in side profile, caption "Arch support that holds all shift". Thin vertical divider between halves; the shoe must not overlap the illustration.

concepts.angle: Mechanism proof: cushioning that collapses vs support that holds
concepts.based_on: Library C17 (approved-looking in batch 1); Stepprs old-vs-new split (386 days)
concepts.headline: Your foam gives up at hour 4. Your shift doesn't.
concepts.prompt: Split ad. Left half on light grey: close-up photo of a worn generic grey foam insole (no brand), flattened and cracked at the heel, labeled "YOUR FOAM AT HOUR 4" with three red X lines: "Flat at the heel", "Arch collapsed", "Standing on plastic". Right half on white: the shoe from the reference photo in side profile, fully inside the frame, labeled in purple "BUILT FOR HOUR 12" with three green check lines: "Arch built into the shoe", "Cushioned heel", "No insoles needed". Bottom full-width purple band with white text: "Your shift doesn't end at hour 4. Neither should your shoes."

concepts.angle: Retargeting social proof with real review language
concepts.based_on: Library C04; 'Didn't buy yet? Read what customers are saying' (3.05 ROAS); Trustpilot 5★ phrases
concepts.headline: Didn't buy yet? Read what nurses are saying.
concepts.prompt: Ad that looks like a stack of three social-media comment bubbles over a softly blurred hospital break room photo. Top headline in bold white on a dark band: "Didn't buy yet?" second line "Read what nurses are saying." Comment bubbles (white, rounded, grey generic avatar circles, no names): "Great for my 12 hour shifts", "The toe room sold me", "My feet aren't tired after a busy day". Below the bubbles: the shoe from the reference photo on a small white card. Clean and legible, no app logos.

concepts.angle: Peer contagion on the unit

concepts.headline: First it was me. Then 3 more nurses on my floor.
concepts.prompt: Photo-real ad: overhead shot of four pairs of feet in scrubs standing in a circle on a hospital floor, all wearing the shoe from the reference photo. Top headline in bold black on a white band: "First it was me." second line in purple: "Then 3 more nurses on my floor."

concepts.angle: Nursing students: first clinicals, first 12-hour days

concepts.angle: Cost math: what foot pain costs a year vs one pair

concepts.headline: What your feet cost you this year
concepts.prompt: Ad: a realistic long paper store receipt on a light grey background, titled in receipt font "WHAT YOUR FEET COST THIS YEAR" with lines: "Gel insoles x3 ..... $75", "Pain relievers ..... $40", "Custom orthotics ..... $300", "Running shoes x2 ..... $260", and a bold total "TOTAL ..... $675". Next to the receipt: the shoe from the reference photo with a purple price tag reading "$59.95".

frames.edit: Remove the shoe and the purple price tag, and remove the TOTAL line from the receipt.
Remove the receipt lines "Custom orthotics ..... $300" and "Running shoes x2 ..... $260", leaving blank receipt paper.
